# fmc_device_eigrp (Resource)

This resource manages a Device EIGRP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_device_eigrp" "example" {
  device_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  as_number = "100"
  networks = [
    {
      id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
    }
  ]
  auto_summary = false
  passive_interfaces = [
    {
      id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
    }
  ]
  neighbors = [
    {
      interface_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
      host_id      = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
    }
  ]
  filter_rules = [
    {
      filter_direction        = "INBOUND"
      standard_access_list_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
      interface_id            = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
    }
  ]
  redistributions = [
    {
      redistribute_protocol = "STATIC"
      route_map_id          = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
      metric_bandwidth      = 1000
      metric_delay          = 100
      metric_reliability    = 255
      metric_loading        = 1
      metric_mtu            = 1500
    }
  ]
  summary_addresses = [
    {
      interface_id            = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
      network_id              = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
      administrative_distance = 5
    }
  ]
  interfaces = [
    {
      interface_id            = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
      interface_type          = "PhysicalInterface"
      hello_interval          = 10
      hold_time               = 30
      split_horizon           = false
      delay_time              = 20
      md5_authentication      = true
      authentication_key_type = "UNENCRYPTED"
      authentication_key_id   = 2
      authentication_key      = "my_secret"
    }
  ]
  router_id                                       = "10.10.10.1"
  default_information_in_standard_access_list_id  = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  default_information_out_standard_access_list_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  administrative_distance_internal                = 90
  administrative_distance_external                = 170
  log_neighbor_changes                            = true
  log_neighbor_warnings                           = true
  log_neighbor_warnings_interval                  = 15
  stub_receive_only                               = false
  stub_advertise_connected                        = true
  stub_advertise_redistributed                    = false
  stub_advertise_static                           = false
  stub_advertise_summary                          = true
  default_metric_bandwidth                        = 1000
  default_metric_delay_time                       = 100
  default_metric_reliability                      = 255
  default_metric_loading                          = 1
  default_metric_mtu                              = 1500
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `as_number` (String) Autonomous System (AS) number of the EIGRP process.
- `device_id` (String) Id of the parent device.
- `networks` (Attributes List) Networks or Hosts that participate in the EIGRP routing process. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

### Optional

- `administrative_distance_external` (Number) Administrative distance for EIGRP external routes.
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `administrative_distance_internal` (Number) Administrative distance for EIGRP internal routes.
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `auto_summary` (Boolean) Advertise summary routes to other EIGRP routers.
  - Default value: `false`
- `cluster_ipv4_pool_id` (String) IPv4 Address Pool ID used for router ID assignment on clustered devices.
- `default_information_in_standard_access_list_id` (String) Standard Access List ID used to accept exterior default routing information.
- `default_information_out_standard_access_list_id` (String) Standard Access List ID used to advertise exterior default routing information.
- `default_metric_bandwidth` (Number) Default metric bandwidth (in Kbps) for redistributed routes.
  - Range: `1`-`4294967295`
- `default_metric_delay_time` (Number) Default metric delay (in tens of microseconds) for redistributed routes.
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
- `default_metric_loading` (Number) Default metric effective bandwidth (loading) for redistributed routes.
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `default_metric_mtu` (Number) Default metric path MTU (in bytes) for redistributed routes.
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `default_metric_reliability` (Number) Default metric reliability for redistributed routes.
  - Range: `0`-`255`
- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `filter_rules` (Attributes List) Filter rules (distribute lists) for EIGRP routing updates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_rules))
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) EIGRP interface settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `log_neighbor_changes` (Boolean) Enable logging of EIGRP neighbor adjacency changes.
- `log_neighbor_warnings` (Boolean) Enable logging of EIGRP neighbor warning messages.
- `log_neighbor_warnings_interval` (Number) Interval (in seconds) between repeated neighbor warning messages.
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `neighbors` (Attributes List) EIGRP neighbors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--neighbors))
- `passive_interfaces` (Attributes List) Interfaces as passive (do not send or receive routing updates). Applicable only when `passive_interfaces_all` is not set to true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--passive_interfaces))
- `passive_interfaces_all` (Boolean) Set all interfaces as passive (do not send or receive routing updates).
- `redistributions` (Attributes List) Redistributions to the EIGRP routing process. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redistributions))
- `router_id` (String) IPv4 address used as the router ID. Do not configure for AUTOMATIC router ID selection.
- `stub_advertise_connected` (Boolean) EIGRP stub router advertises connected routes.
- `stub_advertise_redistributed` (Boolean) EIGRP stub router advertises redistributed routes.
- `stub_advertise_static` (Boolean) EIGRP stub router advertises static routes.
- `stub_advertise_summary` (Boolean) EIGRP stub router advertises summary routes.
- `stub_receive_only` (Boolean) Configure the device as a receive-only EIGRP stub router.
- `summary_addresses` (Attributes List) Summary addresses advertised on interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary_addresses))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'EigrpRoute'.

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Required:

- `id` (String) Network object ID.


<a id="nestedatt--filter_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter_rules`

Required:

- `filter_direction` (String) Filter direction.
  - Choices: `INBOUND`, `OUTBOUND`
- `standard_access_list_id` (String) Standard Access List ID, that defines the networks that are to be received and suppressed in routing updates.

Optional:

- `interface_id` (String) Id of interface to which the filter rule applies.
- `routing_process` (String) Routing process whose routes are filtered. Applicable only for `OUTBOUND` direction.
  - Choices: `CONNECTED`, `BGP`, `OSPF`, `RIP`, `STATIC`
- `routing_process_id` (String) OSPF process ID or BGP AS number.


<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Required:

- `interface_id` (String) Interface ID.
- `interface_type` (String) Interface type.

Optional:

- `authentication_key` (String, Sensitive) Authentication key.
- `authentication_key_id` (Number) Authentication key ID.
  - Range: `0`-`255`
- `authentication_key_type` (String) Authentication key encryption.
  - Choices: `UNENCRYPTED`, `ENCRYPTED`, `AUTHKEY`
- `delay_time` (Number) Throughput delay (in tens of microseconds).
  - Range: `1`-`16777215`
- `hello_interval` (Number) Interval (in seconds) between hello transmissions.
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
  - Default value: `5`
- `hold_time` (Number) Time (in seconds) before the neighbor is considered down.
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
  - Default value: `15`
- `md5_authentication` (Boolean) Enable MD5 authentication.
- `split_horizon` (Boolean) Enable split horizon.


<a id="nestedatt--neighbors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `neighbors`

Required:

- `host_id` (String) Id of Host object representing the neighbor.
- `interface_id` (String) Id of interface through which the neighbor is reachable.


<a id="nestedatt--passive_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `passive_interfaces`

Required:

- `id` (String) Interface ID.


<a id="nestedatt--redistributions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redistributions`

Required:

- `redistribute_protocol` (String) Protocol to redistribute.
  - Choices: `CONNECTED`, `BGP`, `OSPF`, `RIP`, `STATIC`

Optional:

- `match_external_1` (Boolean) Whether to match OSPF external type 1 routes.
- `match_external_2` (Boolean) Whether to match OSPF external type 2 routes.
- `match_internal` (Boolean) Whether to match OSPF internal routes.
- `match_nssa_external_1` (Boolean) Whether to match OSPF NSSA external type 1 routes.
- `match_nssa_external_2` (Boolean) Whether to match OSPF NSSA external type 2 routes.
- `metric_bandwidth` (Number) Metric bandwidth (in Kbps).
  - Range: `1`-`4294967295`
- `metric_delay` (Number) Metric delay (in tens of microseconds).
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
- `metric_loading` (Number) Metric effective bandwidth (loading). 255 indicates 100 percent loading.
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `metric_mtu` (Number) Metric path MTU (in bytes).
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `metric_reliability` (Number) Metric reliability. The value 255 indicates 100 percent reliability; 0 means no reliability.
  - Range: `0`-`255`
- `process_id` (String) OSPF process ID or BGP AS number.
- `route_map_id` (String) Route map ID for route filtering.


<a id="nestedatt--summary_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary_addresses`

Required:

- `interface_id` (String) Id of interface on which the summary address is advertised.
- `network_id` (String) Network object ID of the summary address.

Optional:

- `administrative_distance` (Number) Administrative distance of the summary route.
  - Range: `1`-`255`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain> is optional. If not provided, `Global` is used implicitly and resource's `domain` attribute is not set.
terraform import fmc_device_eigrp.example "<domain>,<device_id>,<id>"
```
